decisions.reason: Because the waterproof lined safety shoe range was only visible at launch and not shown thereafter, its performance likely fell short of aspiration levels and, given its closeness to the core range, the firm would reallocate the resources to stronger established lines or new development.

Because the electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe appeared only in 2019 and then disappeared from the website, management would read this as weak evidence of market traction relative to aspirations and redirect resources to better-performing core products or search projects.

Because the safety shoe series was mentioned only in its launch year despite a growing market and the firm’s broad established offer, the likely shortfall versus aspiration would lead management to discontinue it and free capacity for more promising products.
